title: Glessner's south chimney checked against the HABS drawings
items: Nothing you can see changed. In J. W. Taylor's photograph of the Glessner house the south chimney stands about a foot and a half north of where the model draws it. The 1960s survey drawings were checked to see whether the model had the chimney in the wrong place. Both drawings put the chimney where the model already has it, so it stays. The mismatch comes from how the photograph's camera has been reconstructed, and fixing that is the next task.
